answer: Mechanism: Operator-Anchored Clawback (OAC). Each wallet presents a signed operator attestation (cloud billing root, HSM key). The protocol treats each root as an island and tracks a rolling horizon of wallet creation. A suspicious plume of wallets from one root triggers cluster-wide rate limits; confirmed sybil activity claws back the operator’s non-transferable service reputation and raises its future task-credit requirements. Wallet balances stay untouched. Attacker must provision many independent operator roots with real attestation and liability, not just wallets.
